mentions.h: Ted Pallant: President of Belgrave Harriers 1996-1997
mentions.note: President 1996-1997; born 1929 at St George's Hospital, Hyde Park; member since 1957; club kit seller; ran Polytechnic Road Relay 1963 and the '5¾' 1966; Social Secretary late 1950s-early 1960s; committee until 1965; chairs Membership Services committee; SEAA committee

photos.c: September 21st 1963 and Ted strides out in the Polytechnic Road Relay at Chiswick.

Left: Nearly two miles gone in the '5¾'. It's September 1966 and among the 39 competitors in the race, this bunch are out to settle personal scores - or perhaps just enjoy the sunshine. The runners are: Financial wizards Keith Miller (106) and Jim Heathfield (93), Ted Pallant (94), talented youth and junior Tony Brooks (37) - lost to the sport before making impact as a senior, Dave McMillan (12) - now fighting back from terrible injuries sustained while out training and hit by a car, P.Blair-Fish (46).

The traditional team photo before the start of the first Surrey League Race. Back row - Bruce Barton, Geremew Wolde, Rex Bale, Mike Webb, Don Anderson, Gerry Adams, Darryl Ochse, Alasdair McLean Foreman, Roger Alsop, Adam Cowmeadow, Tony Barden, Kevin Quinn, Pete Gilbey, Harry Corbett, Erwenn Lemenager, Rob Harding, Andy Brown, Ted Pallant. Front row: Rob McHarg, Steve Clarke, Will Cockerell, Eric Hall (President), Junior Galley, Jamie Kirton, Elvis Rimdap, Roy Collier, Aldis Ulrych.

Left: Getting ready for the "off" at Brockwell Park. Stuart Paton, Ted Pallant (President), Alex Luce, Rob Harding, Marlon Anderson (obscured), Steve Hewes, Said Chettati, Gerry Adams, Charlie Dickinson, Mike Nouch, Jim Estall, Derek Manning (behind), Tony Binda, Roger Alsop, Mick Graham (behind), Matt Yates, Alan Mead, Bruce Barton (behind), Bill Bull.
Left:  Ted Pallant, President, congratulates Past President Bill Lucas on his achievements.

Left: Enjoying the occasion.  Pat Mead, Tony Binda, Marianne Black, Gerry North, Alan Black, the late Laurie O'Hara, George Piddington, Charlie Henn, Ted Pallant, Chris Steer, Charlie Manning.

Sadly this was the last time that we saw Laurie O'Hara.  He died the following day while out running.
Below:  Snowy Brooks, Ted Pallant and Sheila, Bill Lucas and Sheena enjoy the festivities at Belgrave Hall on April 19th.
Above: Ted Pallant and Denis Brickwood recall old days and enjoy the 'spread'.
(g) In his last week as Club President 1996-97, Ted Pallant checks out Team Manager Alan Mead's calculations – " ... yes, we've just moved into 1st place in the Surrey Road Relay."
